blocks.text: A “blue wave” has rolled across the United States, with some even calling it a “blue tsunami.” The Democrats scored a decisive victory in the midterm elections on November 3, wresting the majority from President Donald Trump’s Republicans in both the US House of Representatives and the Senate. They also won gubernatorial elections in former Republican strongholds such as Texas. Pictures from Tuesday evening show Democrat politicians and supporters across the country celebrating, hugging, even weeping with joy. However, as the White House reminded Americans in a post on X the day after the elections: “Trump is still your president.” Trump […]...
